messages:
Leah: Quick announcement — launching the Plugin Bounty Sprint and the contrib-connector-kit v0.1.0 right now :tada:
Leah: tl;dr: new repo with connector templates, onboarding guides, and 6 initial issues marked ‘good first bounty’. We’re putting $2k in microgrants for community maintainers this quarter. Apply link below.
Leah: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-connector-kit
Leah: Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-connector-kit/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Leah: Quick install snippet:
Leah: ```
Leah: # npm
Leah: npm install @redwood/contrib-connector-kit@0.1.0
Leah: # or yarn
Leah: yarn add @redwood/contrib-connector-kit@0.1.0
Leah: ```
Leah: Office hours for maintainers: Thu 10:00am PT (calendar link in the repo README). Please ping me if that time doesn't work.
release-bot: Release v0.1.0 published by @Leah — changelog: minor templates, bugfixes, CI improvements. https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-connector-kit/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Sam: Amazing work team! :clap: Quick Q — do maintainers need to sign a CLA for the bounty tasks or is the contributor license covered by the repo CONTRIBUTING.md?
Leah: Good Q — we require the standard CLA for anything that receives a payout. CONTRIBUTING.md highlights that and links the CLA flow. We'll add a short checklist in the bounty issue template.
Priya: Adding: I'll update the docs with a step-by-step on CLA + payout flow and drop the office-hours agenda. Also scheduling an extra session for EMEA folks.
Ethan: How do people apply for the microgrants? Is it first-come-first-serve or merit-based?
Leah: Apply via the Google form in the repo (link in the release notes). We’ll prioritize active contributions and cross-project utility, but we expect to fund multiple small teams. Not strictly FCFS.
Sam: Nice. Can we also add a note about commercial use / licensing so partners know the connectors are under the repo license?
Leah: Yes — license is Apache 2.0, will call that out in the release blurb and README.
Priya: I'll draft the announcement post for the community newsletter and schedule tweets. Want to include a 30s demo clip — anyone got a short screencast?
Ethan: I can record a quick demo this afternoon, 30s should be fine.
Sam: :eyes: tagging @eng-ml for visibility — might want to highlight any model-compatibility notes.
Leah: Thanks all. If you want to triage a bounty issue, label it with `bounty-claimed` and ping me. We'll track microgrant disbursement in the spreadsheet linked in the repo.
Priya: LGTM. Pumped to see community momentum here. :rocket:
